plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Operations Management, Bachelor of Applied Science' program page (Major Code: 8122B), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/business-and-information-systems-department/operations-management/operations-management-bachelor-of-applied-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Bachelor of Applied Science (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). This is a degree-completion BAS (program_type 'completion'): the 60-credit pre-admission AAS block transfers in and only the 60-credit post-admission sequence is published semester-by-semester. Modeled on the AAS Concentration (the flagship BAS path): semester 1 is the published 'Pre-Admission Requirements (AAS Concentration)' block - 5 listed GE courses (15 cr) plus the catalog-required 45 credits from the student's accredited CTE/AAS program, modeled as one 45-credit transfer block (student's earned AAS). Semesters 2-5 are the published Fall/Spring Junior/Senior tables (15/15/15/15). Total 120 = the catalog's published total. REPEATED COURSE (official catalog): 'ENGL 101 Writing and Rhetoric I' is printed in BOTH the pre-admission block and Fall Semester Junior Year; the catalog's post-admission semesters include remaining GE core for students whose AAS did not include them ('36 credits of general education core classes; 15 credits will have been completed through the AAS degree'), so the code legitimately appears twice; plan sets allow_repeated_courses per the validator contract. Variable credit: 'SCIG GE Any Gen. Ed. Science Course 3-4 Credits' in Fall Senior modeled at 3 (minimum-credit path). Choice slots: 'BUSA 201 Business Communications OR ENGL 202 Technical Communication' (both 3 cr); COMM GE / MATH GE / SOCS GE / ELEC GE / HUMA GE1 / HUMA GE2 / SCIG GE / SCIG GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). The catalog notes the ELEC GE 'should not be of the same discipline as' the SOCS GE course. The same page also publishes an AA/AS Concentration (60-credit AA/AS block + 21 credits of CTE coursework + the junior/senior tables with CTE courses); per the one-plan-per-major corpus convention only the AAS Concentration is modeled here. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
